## Risks
1. **The 2026-09-19 incident can happen again.** If a developer's shell has a production `API_TOKEN`, any test or dev-server code that calls `resolveToken` without a token now uses it silently. Only `token.test.mjs` clears the variable; future test files won't get that protection automatically. A runner-level guard (for example, clearing `API_TOKEN` in the `test` script) would cover them. I didn't add one because it's outside the brief.
2. **Code that relied on the throw now behaves differently.** Nothing in this repo does that, but outside code that caught the error to detect a missing configuration will now get the env token instead.
3. **An explicit empty token falls back to the env token,** as described above. A caller passing an empty config value gets the env token instead of an error.
4. **The error text changed.** Anything matching the old "pass { token } explicitly" string will stop matching. Nothing in this repo does.
5. **The token's origin is no longer visible at the call site,** which was the second reason in the old record.
